from，来自（分隔双方呼号，如 BG4XYZ DE JA1ABC）: from (separates the two callsigns, e.g. BG4XYZ DE JA1ABC)
over，请讲（邀请对方发射）: over (invites the other station to transmit)
发送前先听，确认频率空闲再呼叫。: Listen before transmitting; confirm the frequency is clear, then call.
对方发送时耐心等待，使用 K/BK 正确交接。: Wait patiently while the other station sends, and hand over correctly with K/BK.
报呼号至少两遍，速度以对方能抄收为准。: Send your callsign at least twice, at a speed the other station can copy.
祝福（对女士，love and kisses）: Best wishes (to a woman: love and kisses)
结束用 73 或 SK，简洁清晰。: Close with 73 or SK — brief and clear.
结束通联，silent key（也指已故台友）: End of contact; silent key (also used for a deceased ham)
频率是否被占用（Q 简语）: Whether the frequency is in use (Q code)
